name: Federal Individual Income Tax
notes: A graduated tax: each rate applies only to the income inside its bracket. For a single filer in tax year 2025 the brackets are 10% to $11,925; 12% to $48,475; 22% to $103,350; 24% to $197,300; 32% to $250,525; 35% to $626,350; and 37% above that. Thresholds differ by filing status and are adjusted annually. Revenue collected has not yet been sourced.
